quests.name: Mule Daily
intro: Shapeshift into a mule to carry a high amount of something to an NPC. Reward depends on which random NPC you're sent to.
items: 1.     2 Mule Glyphs and mule level for at least 1,200 EMU.
2.     1 set of essences for Teleport to Portals Room spell

steps.text: Go to Tatu in Desert Pines Crystal Caverns [108,16] and choose option "Need help?"
You will need to have 1,200 EMU available. Shapeshift to mule form before accepting the package.
You will get 600 quartz in inventory and will need to deliver it to an NPC
Easiest way to move to the NPC in mule form (mules can't use magic):

sub.text: Shapeshift to mule form and get the package.
Cast teleport to portals room spell.
Shapeshift to mule form again and walk to the portal of the map you're going to.
Walk to the NPC and deliver the package.

steps.text: Talk to the NPC and give them the quartz for the reward.
